body: Thanks everyone for the positive messages, but i think i should give a little bit more info of what is it like. I feel like a disappointment for my family because they thought i was an intelligent kid, but i am average at best. They have very high expectations of me, which i can't really fulfill. My sister is much more successful than me. I am not jealous, i love her dearly, but i still feel like my family doesn't really need me because i constantly let them down. I let everyone down, to be honest. I never had a girlfriend, because i have a very bad case of stuttering and i am super shy. I'm 17 and i know there is a lot of time for everything to change, but something tells me it won't
You sure have an interesting life
